question: Selling price of a glass is Rs. 1287 and loss percentage is 22 percent. If selling price is Rs. 1848. then what will be the profit percentage?
solution:
Given:

Selling price of a glass is Rs. 1287 and loss percentage is 22 percent.

2nd selling price is Rs. 1848

Calculation:

As per the question,

The cost price is,

⇒ 1287 × 100 /78 = Rs 1650

2nd selling price is Rs. 1848

Net profit is ,

1848 - 1650 = Rs 198

Profit percentage is ,

(198 / 1650) × 100 = 12%
